application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.note: Neither the release nor its paper or record states the cell chemistry.

units_released.note: Rule: one vehicle (the twelve files are days of the same car). Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.note: The release gives pack- or system-level signals and no cell topology.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: No individual cell-voltage channels are released.

energy_mwh.note: Present usable energy computed from the data: coulomb counting over runs of at least 40 points of SOC with no gap over 300 s, ampere-hours per 100 percent SOC times mean pack voltage, median per unit, summed.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from the released data

span_unit_years.note: one car on 12 separate days: unit-years is first to last record (the v1.1 rule for releases with calendar timestamps); the 12 days' recorded time is given for reference

obs_hours.note: Calendar spans are measurable, so observation-hours are not used.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.17632/mm9rvfvmrb.3; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
